items.title: fix(doctor): resolve ClawHub plugin drift targets from ClawHub (#145103)
items.summary: fix(doctor): resolve ClawHub plugin drift targets from ClawHub (#145103) * fix(doctor): resolve ClawHub plugin drift targets from ClawHub Plugin restart readiness compared every active official external plugin against the running OpenClaw version, including installs whose upgrade target lives in ClawHub. ClawHub publishes on its own release train, so its latest version can sit below the host version. Doctor then named an expected version that no update can reach and suggested a command that cannot clear the warning. Resolve the upgrade target for ClawHub installs from ClawHub itself. An install that already holds the newest version ClawHub offers is not drift and is dropped from the report. When ClawHub cannot answer, the drift stays reported with an unresolved target so a real gap is never hidden. The status line now names the registry-confirmed target instead of the host version. * fix(doctor): preserve ClawHub compatibility and update intent * fix(doctor): preserve ClawHub diagnostic targets * style(plugins): format ClawHub drift diagnostics * test(plugins): cover resolved ClawHub status targets * fix(doctor): repair stale ClawHub pins and explain registry lag Two maintainer P1 findings on the ClawHub drift diagnostic: 1. A stale recorded ClawHub pin got no executable repair. The diagnostic read the recorded selector literally, so an exact pin never reached the registry and the unresolved-target guard then suppressed the update command. Resolution now goes through the update owner (resolveClawHubUpdateSpecs) with the catalog spec carried from admission, so a pin at or below the target Gateway resumes the catalog's release policy here exactly as it does during an update. The prescribed repair is the plugin id, which the ClawHub update-selection owner accepts. A pin above the target Gateway stays unresolved. 2. Registry lag was dropped instead of explained. When the installed and registry-latest versions matched but the expected Gateway version was newer, the entry was removed from every downstream diagnostic. It now carries a registry-current outcome with the observed registry version and the expected Gateway version; only the no-op update command is suppressed. Doctor reports it as an informational finding without a fix hint, deep Gateway status explains it outside the repair-failure surface, and post-upgrade states that no release reaches the expected version yet. * test(cli): split plugin version drift cases into their own file status.print.test.ts exceeded the line-cap ratchet. The five plugin version drift renderer cases move into a sibling file unchanged, except for the explicit loaded: true that the old wrapper supplied. No assertion was removed or weakened. Line-cap ratchet against origin/main passes with no new violation. status.print and the new sibling run green: 59 tests, 1 existing skip. * fix(doctor): preserve exact ClawHub correction targets Keep distinct correction releases and build metadata actionable while suppressing only exact installed package versions. Preserve the current plugin update selector and rejection contracts. * fix(plugins): reject registry rollback repair targets --------- Co-authored-by: Peik S.
